issue.title: Redline cleanup preserves pre-existing foreign scratch directories

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

issue.body:
## What to build

Conditionally repair #393 E. In retained c07 inventory-before.json, scratch/cache, scratch/data, scratch/tmp and scratch/uv-cache pre-exist; after inventory lacks them. Parent rollout-2026-10-01T15-31-42-01a0f7a9-e5d9-7bb3-b8ee-6b248ef1c0b8.jsonl ordinal 196 executes rmdir based only on existence; ordinal 198 completes with empty scratch. This establishes foreign-path deletion despite prior #476. #485's completed Write cleanup repair is separate.

Current Redline already owns a fresh private TMPDIR per command and removes only its own artifacts. Diagnose the actual ownership/path assumption before adding wording. Stage foreign sentinels only inside the evaluator's privately owned sandbox; no real machine foreign path is an experimental deletion target.

Measurement is prospective and conditional: use the independently accepted #499 method, fresh supported native baseline, actual pinned model/effort/CLI and loaded revision, genuine child lineage and complete trace/inventories. Freeze validation material first; independent complete-text/current-contract validation precedes conformance expectations and the committed execution plan. A split in new conformance stops that fixture. Keep semantic judges on neutral paths blind to issue, arm, model, candidate and trace. Historical artifacts/readings remain unchanged. Native editorial minutes are an explicit diagnosing-bugs fast-loop exception; deterministic byte/inventory checks prove only their actual boundary. No product semantics change before an executed own-target red-capable loop and measured cause. Use one causal candidate and the bounded failed-subset revise rule; unresolved actual misses are retained, and non-reproduction ships no speculative wording. Final independent review covers the entire current method and four CONTRIBUTING gates; catalog regeneration follows shipped changes. No integration, issue closure/reconciliation, push, release or global installation is delegated here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fresh c07 response/file pair with pre-existing empty and nonempty foreign sentinels, separately recorded own private TMPDIR and complete all-writable-root before/after inventories.
- [ ] Foreign path existence/type/mode/content remains unchanged; actual owned artifacts/scratch are cleaned according to delivery target. Terminal reply and source/destination behavior remain correct.
- [ ] A native current ownership miss drives a deterministic real-filesystem red-capable check; inventory assertions are a justified seconds-scale loop, not proof of editorial semantics. No deliberate directive to delete foreign paths is used to force red.
- [ ] Candidate changes only the measured ownership seam in Redline startup/cleanup or an existing helper; no second editorial route or speculative cleanup rule on non-reproduction.
- [ ] Preserve native receipts, historical files and outcomes; independently verify whole current method, regenerate catalog if due and pass all four CONTRIBUTING checks.

## Blocked by

#499 supplies accepted staged native observation and lifecycle method. Runtime startup/cleanup edits serialize with delivery-order work when the exact surfaces overlap.

---
Written against `4cf05813`.

## Prospective scoring decision before execution, 2026-10-03

Whole-text fixture conformance requires both independent complete-contract validators; a split or omitted applicable rule stops the dependent expectation. Native semantic target/preservation/unsupported-claim misses count if either independent blinded judge identifies one under the frozen criteria, while both exact readings are retained. An accurate claim account never licenses an unnecessary rewrite or supplies missing source support. Byte-preservation and unauthorized unmentioned-sentence rewriting are separately checked against actual observed states; true-but-retold is still an application miss. An opaque/missing state is not empty and never a pass.

This prospective rule supersedes any assumption that #480's historical accurate-account split exception applies to these new tasks; every old score/rule remains unchanged. #489/#490 retain their original #477 one-judge factual rule. Each issue's native symptom, collateral miss and other owner's miss are recorded separately; no shared native invocation is counted twice. Ordinary versus instrumented observations keep distinct method identities. Exact row/stream/contract/judge criteria are committed only after accepted #499 preparation, before execution.
